item.title: A Security Analysis of WhatsApp iOS Mobile Application
item.description: This research presents an investigation into WhatsApp’s on-device data storage on iOS. WhatsApp is one of the most widely used messaging application and hence it is required that a secured on-device storage mechanism be implemented to complement Apple’s security measures for their devices. This will help protect a user’s data in instances where his/her device is compromised physically. The research presents a security analysis on the storage format of data used by WhatsApp on end-users’ devices.
